text_block_list.text:
Gold Ship seems to be looking for 
something in the plaza.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
*Sigh*... Nothing good ever comes from 
late-night impulses.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
I wanted to send McQueen on a treasure 
hunt, so in the dead of night, I hid a 
cake shop discount coupon.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
While I was hiding it, though, I realized 
it wasn't a cake shop coupon, it was a 
sticker with my own photo on it.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
We can't just let some random person 
snatch up a gift meant for Golshi fans 
across the entire universe, can we?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
"That's why I've been pulling an 
all-nighter right up until now busily 
collecting them all..."

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Hey, you help out too! You're my Trainer, 
aren't you?!

After that, I managed to collect all the 
stickers, but Gold Ship looked utterly 
exhausted from staying up all night...
